messages.subject: matrixInput of shinyIncubator package got broken
parts:
One of my apps, based on matrixInput from shinyIncubator no longer works locally. The same code on the spark.rstudio server still works:

http://spark.rstudio.com/toche/demo-dynamic-matrix

The code is here:

runGist("https://gist.github.com/ptoche/8385584")

The message in the console is:

Shiny URLs starting with /tableinput will mapped to /Users/PatrickToche/R/library/shinyIncubator/tableinput
Error in class(val) <- splitName[[2]] : 
  invalid to set the class to matrix unless the dimension attribute is of length 2 (was 0)

The problem seems to have appeared in the last month or so. I cannot say if it's a shiny problem, a shinyIncubator problem or, more likely, a problem with my code to begin with. I'm a beginner and wrote this app by piecing together stuff, so there may be some unsafe code in there.

A fix or workaround would be appreciated as I'm using the relevant code in an app that I use regularly as a tool (not daily, I can wait). Thanks!

I googled the error message and was guided to this place, where the error message would appear to come from here (I think, not sure though, don't quote me on that):

messages.author: b949e0841d7e094b
messages.subject: Re: matrixInput of shinyIncubator package got broken
parts:
May have been a problem with the development version of shiny I had recently installed (can't remember which or when, but in the last couple of weeks or so), because:

remove.packages("shiny")
devtools::install_github("shiny", "rstudio")

fixed this and other problems that started cropping up.
